question.text: Historical Simulation VaR at 5% confidence uses:

answer.text: The mean and standard deviation of returns
The 5th percentile of historical returns, arranged in ascending order

explanation.text: The Logic: Historical simulation = sort past returns, pick the 5th percentile (or 1st for 99%). No distributional assumption. The Trap: Parametric uses mean/SD; Monte Carlo uses RNG. Historical is non-parametric. Cross-Exam Context: XXI-B-specific. Manager's Pro-Tip: Historical VaR captures actual past fat tails but assumes history repeats — extend the look-back period to stabilise estimates.
